slices.summary: After a dark winter stretch, Nina brings Marisa soup and a stack of Tacoma maritime history books; this shifts Marisa's evening reading from mystery paperbacks to shoreline industry history and creates a grounding winter ritual.
decisions: Marisa's bedtime reading became more specifically focused on Tacoma maritime history and shoreline industry histories.
